خاک کو اب اے مرے مولیٰ تو گوہر بار کر
poems.bangla_translation:
Cultivate this wasteland of the heart with your holy name,
The gray soil is now Ogo Mola! bejeweled
poems.sharh: Hazrat Wala (R.A.) said: When the soul becomes barren and dry like a desert due to sin, only the remembrance of Allah and Khalees repentance can transform that soil into a fruitful and bejeweled garden.

poems.title: Begging and dependence on kindness
poems.original_text:
نگاہِ لطف فرماؤ کرم کی بھیک دے جاؤ
تمہارے نام پر ہم نے زمانہ چھوڑ رکھا ہے
poems.bangla_translation:
Give a little look of kindness, beg for mercy,
It is in your name that we have left this mortal world.
poems.sharh: Hazrat Wala (R.A.) said: The best quality of a servant is to be a poor person for the sake of God's mercy. He who renounces the world in honor of Mawla's name is eternally blessed.

poems.title: When the pain is great
poems.original_text:
ہم نے سینے سے لگایا درد کو
درد کو ہم نے دوا سمجھا تری
poems.bangla_translation:
We embrace this pain of love in deep love,
We have known your sorrow and pain as the great medicine of the soul.
poems.sharh: Hazrat Wala (R.A.) said: The burning and burning of God's love is not a destructive disease; Rather, it is the greatest remedy for all spiritual ailments of the soul.

poems.title: Absolute thirst for union
poems.original_text:
تیرے ملنے کی تمنّا نے مٹایا مجھ کو
تیری الفت نے نیا رنگ دکھایا مجھ کو
poems.bangla_translation:
The longing thirst for you has made me selfless,
Your pure love has shown me a new way of life.
poems.sharh: Hazrat Wala (R.A.) said: The longing to meet God burns the inner pride and pettiness of man and brings a new heavenly meaning to life.

poems.title: tears of love
poems.original_text:
دردِ دل دے دے مجھے تو اپنی الفت کے طفیل
زندگی بن جائے گی مولیٰ ترے غم کے طفیل
poems.bangla_translation:
With the help of your supreme love, give that heartache to the heart,
Life will become worthwhile only with the blessing of your sadness.
poems.sharh: Hazrat Wala (R.A.) said: The tears of God's tears are the fruits of Paradise. In whose heart this compassion takes place, his life becomes illuminated by the light of Mawla's mercy.

poems.title: Liberation of mortal maya
poems.original_text:
عشقِ بتاں سے دل کو بچا لے مرے خدا
نورِ یقیں سے قلب کو جلوہ نما بنا
poems.bangla_translation:
Save this heart from the temptation of mortal form O God!
Make the heart shine forever with the light of strong faith.
poems.sharh: Hazrat Wala (RA) advises: Do not pollute the heart by being distracted by the beauty of mortal man. Fill your heart with eternal light by loving Allah.

poems.title: Invocation of Holy Vision
poems.original_text:
نظر کو پاک رکھ اے دل کہ یہ پیغامِ فطرت ہے
تجلی گاہِ حق تو قلبِ انساں کی حقیقت ہے
poems.bangla_translation:
Oh Dil! Keep your vision pure, this is the call of Fitra.
The manifestation of God's light is the reality of the human heart.
poems.sharh: Hazrat Wala (RA) said: Protecting the eyes from impermissible glances is the main condition for safeguarding faith. The heart of man is the place of revelation of God; Let no mortal doll enter there.

poems.title: The cool shade of mercy
poems.original_text:
کرم کے سائے میں دل کو سکون ملتا ہے
ترے کرم کا ہمیں آسرا ہے یا اللہ
poems.bangla_translation:
In the cool shade of your grace, the wretched finds peace.
Your infinite mercy is our only refuge O Allah!
poems.sharh: Hazrat Wala (RA) said: When you stand under the shade of Allah's endless mercy and forgiveness, all fear and anxiety melt away like camphor and heavenly tranquility descends upon you.

poems.title: The dignity of love mourning
poems.original_text:
تیرے غم کو میں نے مانا حاصلِ کونین ہے
یہ نہ ہو تو زندگی کا کوئی بھی مقصد نہیں
poems.bangla_translation:
I have known the best achievement of the two worlds in the absence of your love,
Without this pain, life has no meaning.
poems.sharh: Hazrat Wala (RA) said: The love of Allah should be considered as the greatest wealth of the two worlds. He who does not have this love is destitute despite earthly abundance.

poems.title: The inestimable joy of sorrow
poems.original_text:
دل اگر غمگین ہے مولیٰ تری یادوں کے سبب
اس اداسی پر تو لاکھوں خوشیاں قربان ہیں
poems.bangla_translation:
Remembering your love, if you are sad and sad,
However, the happiness of the world is a sacrifice to such virtuous sadness.
poems.sharh: Hazrat Wala (R.A.) said: The heart that grieves and grieves at the remembrance of Allah, all the fleeting pleasures of the world are worth a speck of dust to that holy sadness.

poems.title: Deeder's beggar
poems.original_text:
جن کے دل میں تو بسا ہے ان کو جنت کی کیا پروا
تیرے جلووں کے فدائی تیرے دیدار کے طلبگار
poems.bangla_translation:
In whose hearts you exist, what is the thought of paradise!
The lunatics of your light are only the poor of your holy god.
poems.sharh: Hazrat Wala (R.A.) said: The goal of true Ashek is not only Paradise; On the contrary, gaining closeness to God Himself, the owner of Paradise, is the ultimate pursuit of his life.

poems.title: Cuckoo's eye
poems.original_text:
اک نظر فرمائیے اے مالکِ کون و مکاں
دل کی یہ بستی ترے دیدار کو ترسی ہوئی
poems.bangla_translation:
O master of both worlds, give a glance!
This heartland is thirsty for your vision.
poems.sharh: Hazrat Wala (RA) said: A glimpse of God's mercy is enough to make a sinfully dark heart bright and pure in an instant.

poems.title: light of remembrance
poems.original_text:
تو نے جس دل کو نوازا اپنی یادوں کے سبب
اس کی خلوت بھی ہوئی پرنور جلوت کی طرح
poems.bangla_translation:
The heart which thou hast blessed with the light of thy virtuous remembrance,
Even his solitary solitude became as bright as daylight.
poems.sharh: Hazrat Wala (RA) said: The heart that is occupied with the remembrance of Allah, whether it is in public or in solitary confinement, both of its states are manifested in light.

poems.title: Prostration only
poems.original_text:
شکر ہے مولیٰ ترے در پر جھکا دی یہ جبیں
غیر کے آگے جھکانے سے بچایا آپ نے
poems.bangla_translation:
Thanks Ogo Mola! I bowed this forehead to your holy court,
You are the one who saved me from bowing down at someone else's door.
poems.sharh: Hazrat Wala (R.H.) expressed gratitude and said: The greatest liberation of people is to bow down at the holy door of the Great Lord; Otherwise, people would have to be slaves to thousands of creations.

poems.title: Tears and tears
poems.original_text:
سوزِ دل اور چشمِ تر ہے تیری رحمت کا نشاں
جس کو یہ دولت ملی وہ ہو گیا سب سے غنی
poems.bangla_translation:
A burning heart and bright eyes are good signs of your mercy,
The one who got this treasure is the richest man in the world.
poems.sharh: Hazrat Wala (RA) said: A burning heart and tearful eyes are the signs of becoming a saint. He who is endowed with this spiritual wealth is the richest man in the world.

poems.title: The peace of the dust of love
poems.original_text:
خاک ہو کر بھی ترے کوچے میں جو سوئے رہے
بادشاہوں سے زیادہ چین پایا خواب میں
poems.bangla_translation:
Who lay in dust in thy love's lane,
They found a deeper peace in their sleep than the abundance of kings.
poems.sharh: Hazrat Wala (RA) said: It is much more peaceful and comfortable to lie down in the path of Allah's love than the luxurious bed of the royal palace.

poems.title: Mawla's helping hand
poems.original_text:
تیری جانب جو بڑھاتا ہے ارادے کا قدم
دستگیری کے لیے تیری عنایت آئے گی
poems.bangla_translation:
When towards you the servant takes a step of determination,
Your great mercy and grace come forward to pull you by the hand.
poems.sharh: Hazrat Wala (R.A.) assured: When a servant makes a firm determination to leave sin and move towards God, Allah's help and unseen power come forward to pull him.

poems.title: Waking up from the sleep of ignorance
poems.original_text:
عمر گزری جا رہی ہے غفلتوں کے درمیاں
اب جگا دے قلب کو اس خوابِ سنگین سے مرے
poems.bangla_translation:
How much precious life has passed away in the middle of negligence,
Wake up my unconscious heart from deep sleep.
poems.sharh: Hazrat Wala (RA) warns: Wake up the soul now from the sleep of heedlessness and indifference, otherwise regret at the time of death will be of no use.

poems.title: The lonely call of the night
poems.original_text:
رات کی تنہائیوں میں جب اٹھاتا ہوں یہ ہاتھ
آسماں کے پار سے آتی ہے آوازِ کرم
poems.bangla_translation:
When I raise the two hands of Fariyad in the darkness of the night,
From the other side of the sky came down the call of Mawla's absolute forgiveness.
poems.sharh: Hazrat Wala (R.A.) said: When the servant raised his hand in the last hour of the night, the mercy of Allah called him and said - 'Who are you asking for forgiveness, I will forgive!'

poems.title: The company of God
poems.original_text:
عاشقانِ حق کی محفل میں ہے اک کیفِ عجیب
دل بدل جاتے ہیں اک اک لمحہ کی صحبت کے بعد
poems.bangla_translation:
A unique spiritual sudha prevails in the Majlis of Haque's Asheks,
Hearts are instantly changed after a moment's holy companionship.
poems.sharh: Hazrat Wala (R.A.) said: The wonderful spiritual atmosphere created in the company of the people of Allah, sitting there for a moment melts even the hardest of hearts.

poems.title: best prayer
poems.original_text:
ہم نے مانگا ہے تجھی سے تیرا غم اور تیری دید
دو جہاں کی نعمتیں ہیں اس تقاضے پر نثار
poems.bangla_translation:
I have asked you for the pain of your sorrow and the holy sight.
All the blessings of both worlds are dedicated to this longing.
poems.sharh: Hazrat Mawla (R.A.) says: Seeking Allah's love and pleasure is a thousand times better than seeking worldly wealth. When you find the Mawla, you find everything.

poems.title: Mauler's anchor
poems.original_text:
لاکھ طوفان آئیں لیکن جن کا لنگر تو بنا
ان کی کشتی کو کبھی ڈوبنے کا اندیشہ نہیں
poems.bangla_translation:
May a million storms come, whose anchor and bulwark you are,
There is no danger of their lives drowning.

poems.title: Love's steadfast supremacy
poems.original_text:
یا الٰہی ہر گھڑی تیری محبت کا رہے غلبہ
تیرے غم کے سوا دل میں کوئی اور غم نہ رہے
poems.bangla_translation:
O my God! Let your love rule every moment,
Let there be no other sorrow in your heart except the sorrow of your grief.

poems.title: Sending love to Faizan
poems.original_text:
فیضانِ محبت کا یہ چشمہ رہے جاری سدا
تشنگانِ عشق پیتے رہیں اس جام سے مدام
